stories.title: OpenAI might rebrand its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses’
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI wants to call its data centers (buildings full of computers) something friendlier sounding instead. They are trying to improve how people feel about these large facilities.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who live near data centers. There is nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: AI can make tech CEOs’ lives easier. What about everyone else?
stories.simple_summary: The article discusses how tech company leaders sometimes say things that don't seem to understand regular people's concerns. Their statements can come across as out of touch.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly commentary about how business leaders communicate. Unless you run a tech company, this doesn't directly affect you.

stories.title: Wall Street's Black October: Why the worst may still be ahead
stories.simple_summary: The article headline suggests the stock market had a bad October and might get worse. No details are provided in what was given.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own retirement accounts or investments, stock market changes matter to you. Otherwise, this does not directly affect your daily life.

stories.title: Local mom-and-pops are embracing AI food slop, and residents are revolting
stories.simple_summary: Some local restaurants and food shops are using AI to help make or describe their food, and customers are unhappy about it. People prefer when food is made by actual chefs and cooks.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a small restaurant or food business, your customers care about knowing real people made their food. Using AI for cooking might turn people away.

stories.title: You’ll Never Guess How Scalpers Are Reportedly Snagging Rare iPhone Duos
stories.simple_summary: The headline mentions scalpers (people who buy things just to resell them at higher prices) finding ways to get rare iPhones. Details were not provided.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters if you are trying to buy a specific iPhone model. There is nothing you need to do unless you are shopping for a new phone.

stories.title: Anthropic expands text watermarking to older Claude versions beginning November 3
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic (a company that makes Claude, an AI assistant) is adding hidden marks to text that older versions of Claude create. These marks will prove the text came from AI.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Claude to write things, know that it will now be marked as AI generated. This is mainly useful for people checking whether something was written by AI or a person.

stories.title: AI is disrupting the art of campaigning
stories.simple_summary: AI is changing how political campaigns work. The article does not explain how in the headline.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting to know as you vote and see campaign ads. The details matter more than the headline, so you would need to read the full article.

stories.title: Apple CEO says the company doesn’t ‘want to ship AI for AI’s sake’
stories.simple_summary: Apple's leader says the company will not just add AI features to products for the sake of having them. Apple wants AI to be useful when they use it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Apple products, this means they will take time to make AI features that actually help you instead of rushing them out.

stories.title: 4 days left: How TechCrunch Founder Summit helps you make more useful connections to scale
stories.simple_summary: This is an advertisement for a conference event happening November 4 in Boston where startup founders can meet and network. It is a paid event.
stories.why_it_matters: This only matters if you run a startup company and want to attend networking events. Most small-business owners and retired people will not need this.

stories.title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
stories.simple_summary: A lawsuit says that Elon Musk's xAI company's data center (building full of computers) is polluting the air and breaking environmental laws. A judge allowed the case to continue.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live near the data center in question, this lawsuit might help protect your air quality. Most people in other areas will not be affected.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly lowers funding target for new round
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI tried to raise money from investors but is not getting as much as they had hoped. They are lowering how much money they want to ask for.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who care about OpenAI's business plans. It does not change how the AI works or affect regular users.

stories.title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
stories.simple_summary: Meta created a small AI device shaped like a cute toy that you can carry around. The author mentions making their own version rather than buying Meta's product.
stories.why_it_matters: This is entertainment and product news. You do not need an AI Tamagotchi unless you want one as a fun toy or gift.
